concepts.label: Polymer lab
concepts.definition: The chemistry group's polymer synthesis lab.

memories.text: Wear safety goggles and nitrile gloves in the lab, and do all solvent work inside the fume hood.
Dispose of solvent waste: halogenated and non-halogenated go in separate bins, labelled with date and contents, and never down the sink.

steps: label the bin with date and contents
never pour solvents down the sink
request pickup when the bin is three quarters full

memories.text: Run an acid-base titration: rinse the burette, note the starting volume, add titrant dropwise near the endpoint, and repeat until two titres agree within 0.10 mL.

steps: rinse the burette with the titrant
add titrant dropwise near the endpoint
repeat until two titres agree within 0.10 mL

memories.text: Molarity is moles of solute per litre of solution and changes with temperature.
Molality is moles of solute per kilogram of solvent and does not change with temperature.
memories.note: same words as ch-molarity, different denominator

memories.text: Percent yield is the actual yield divided by the theoretical yield times 100, with the theoretical yield taken from the limiting reagent.

steps: compute the theoretical yield from it
divide the actual yield by the theoretical yield and multiply by 100

memories.text: Round a final result to the significant figures of the least precise measurement that went into it.
The polymerisation gelled because the inhibitor had not been removed from the monomer; pass it through an alumina column first.

fields.situation: a radical polymerisation gels or never starts
fields.insight: the stabiliser was still in the monomer
fields.do_instead: remove the inhibitor on an alumina column

memories.text: In proton NMR the residual solvent peak sits at 7.26 ppm for CDCl3 and 2.50 ppm for DMSO-d6.
Calibrate the pH meter at the start of each day with buffers 4.01, 7.00 and 10.01 and rinse the probe between them.

steps: store the probe in storage solution

memories.text: Store peroxide-forming ethers under nitrogen, write the opening date on the bottle, and discard after six months.
On 2026-10-14 a mislabelled waste bottle caused a minor spill; all waste bins were relabelled.
Look up compound properties in PubChem and reference spectra in the SDBS database.
Record every experiment in the electronic lab notebook on the same day, with batch numbers.
Chose ethyl acetate over dichloromethane for extractions because it is less toxic and easier to dispose of.

fields.rationale: less toxic and easier waste handling

memories.text: Order a new batch of nitrile gloves in size M and L.
